'''Gypsum''' was a type of [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]].<ref name="SotME" /> Twisted [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] of gypsum, known as [[helicite]]s, were found on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]<ref name="SotME" /> and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]' [[Color/Legends|graying]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] looked like gypsum helicites.<ref name="ANHn" /> The [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Resh 9376/Legends|Resh 9376]] was primarily composed of gypsum, [[Granite/Legends|granite]], base [[Ore/Legends|ores]] (such as [[Tin/Legends|tin]], [[Iron/Legends|iron]], and [[Lead/Legends|lead]]), and [[Water/Legends|ice]].<ref name="SaV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Resh_9376.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The comet Resh 9376 was partially composed of gypsum]]
Gypsum was first mentioned in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="ANHn" /> It first appeared in the [[1978]] novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', also written by Foster.<ref name="SotME" />
